svg.title: Who’s in the flagged pile?
svg.desc: Constructed counts with stipulated 90% target catch and 1% other-item flag rates. With 100 targets in 10000 items: 90 of 189 flags are targets, about47.619%. With 5000 targets: 4500 of 4550 flags are targets, about98.901%. Different original population mixes; no real classifier test.

g.text: ANTI HUNTER · FIELD NOTES · CONSTRUCTED COUNTS
90% target catch. 1% other-item flags. In both cases.
The original mix changes the flagged pile.
Complete invented count tables · no measured model or future forecast
